items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: I played with an old piano player by the name of Sid La Prade

ctx.x: well what kind of band was Ben Watkins band was it similar to the bands you were playing with on the river?

similar kind of band yes yes pretty much the same he played a lot of sweet tunes as we call them this was like stars fell on Alabama and things like that as well as the they were pretty much the same and I worked with him for a while and I played with a gig with a lot of other guys I played with an old piano player by the name of Sid La Prade Sid La Prade he was around during the time when they put gold nuggets in the kitty while he played the piano Sid it's L E instead of L A P R O T T I now I may be mistaken
